title: Free Software and Open Source Business

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Today, despite the critical importance of open source to software.
reader_summary.overview: Today, despite the critical importance of open source to software, it’s still seen by some as blasphemous to make money as an open source business. In this podcast, Armon Dadgar, Cofounder and CTO of HashiCorp; Ali Ghodsi, CEO of Databricks. They also cover the most important questions for open source leaders to answer: How do you keep community engaged while building a business?

key_points.text: In this podcast, Armon Dadgar, Cofounder and CTO of HashiCorp; Ali Ghodsi, CEO of Databricks.
What new opportunities does SaaS (software-as-a-service) present?
And if you are a SaaS business, how should you approach cloud service companies, like Amazon Web Services (AWS)?
